query:
UPDATE providers
             SET name = $2, base_url = $3, key_saved_at = $4, updated_at = $5, updated_by = $6,
                 api_key_sealed = CASE $7::text
                     WHEN 'set' THEN $8::bytea
                     WHEN 'clear' THEN NULL
                     ELSE api_key_sealed END
             WHERE id = $1
